name: utm-builder
title: UTM link builder
description: Build a tracked link: a base URL plus source, medium and campaign, with the result live, encoded and ready to copy.
docs: value holds the page and the tags ({ url, source, medium, campaign, term, content }; any you leave out are empty), with defaultValue and onValueChange for the uncontrolled and the reporting side. The link is built live: the page keeps its own parameters and its #fragment, every tag is encoded with encodeURIComponent (a space is %20), tags go in a fixed order, and a utm_ tag already in the address is replaced instead of doubled. Source, medium and campaign are required, term only with requireTerm and content never (it is marked Optional). suggestions gives the names your team already uses, shown as chips under each tag so naming stays consistent; the defaults are a few common sources and mediums. A value with capitals or spaces gets a quiet warning in words (Reports treat Email and email as different sources) and a one-click fix that lower-cases it and puts hyphens for spaces. An address without a scheme is explained and fixed in a click, and an address that is not http or https is refused. The result is a status that settles after typing pauses, and onLinkChange reports the finished link, or null while it is incomplete, at the same moment. baseUrl fills the address and locks it, for when the page is chosen elsewhere. name adds a hidden input with the finished link. locale is for the lists in messages and labels carries every word.
